rule: A striped wallpaper holds two framed boxes. One box contains two-colour motifs, each with exactly one cell of a singly-occurring anchor colour. The other box contains lone marker cells in anchor colours. The output is the marker box cropped with its frame. Each marker is replaced by the motif whose unique anchor has the marker's colour, translated so the anchor lands on the marker.
scope: Wallpaper-framed motif/marker boxes, unique-anchor-colour lookup and translated stamping. Motif body may reuse another marker anchor colour; boxes scale up to 24 across the layout; square canvases 14..30; 1..4 types, 2..8 markers.

authored_scope:
Supported:
- 1-4 motif types from a library of 14 two-colour shapes (each at most 3x3) with random rotation and reflection.
- 2-8 motifs and 2-8 markers.
- Distractor motif types that no marker uses.
- Hard negatives in which a body colour equals another used type's anchor colour, so matching must use singly-occurring colour, not presence.
- Horizontal or vertical stripes with 2+ distinct colours (random: 3-5).
- Stacked or side-by-side boxes.
- Box dimensions conditioned on the canvas and the sampled motif extents. Cross-axis extents go up to min(24, size-2), covering the canonical 20-wide and 19-tall marker boxes.
- Square grids of size 14-30. The original task is always 30x30; smaller sizes are a synthetic extension.
- Explicit latent scenes, used by validate() to reproduce the canonical fixtures exactly.

Deliberately not supported:
- Motifs larger than 3x3 or with more than two colours.
- Thick stripes or non-square grids.
- Clipped or overlapping stamps.
- More than two boxes, and boxes touching the grid border.
- Random sizes below 14.
authored_constraints: Each motif pattern is at most 3x3, has at least 3 cells, uses exactly two colours, is 8-connected, and has exactly one singly-occurring (anchor) colour.
Within a scene, each anchor colour maps to exactly one pattern, including unused distractor types. Explicit scenes that violate this are rejected.
A body colour may equal another type's anchor colour, but never its own anchor colour.
Every marker colour matches exactly one motif type through a singly-occurring colour.
Motifs sit at least one cell inside the motif-box frame and are pairwise separated by at least one cell.
Stamped motifs stay inside the marker interior and are pairwise separated by at least one cell, so markers never touch.
Box interior colours differ from every motif and stamp colour. The marker frame colour is chosen from colours no motif uses.
Boxes are at least 5x5, separated by at least one wallpaper cell, and keep at least one wallpaper cell to the grid border.
There are at least two motifs (so the real motif box outweighs any 3x3 body-ring pseudo-box) and at least two markers (so the real marker box outweighs a single-anchor ring pseudo-box).
Along-axis feasibility: motif extent + 4 + marker stamp extent + 2 + 1 <= size - 2. A packing-area bound is checked before placement.
Random retries are bounded at 300 scene attempts. Sampled scenes that fail the visibility checks are resampled; this never consults a solver.
